Definition
[Homotopy relative to a subspace]

↗ def:homotopy

\group Homotopy Theory

A homotopy $f_t:X\to Y$ is relative to $A$, or rel $A$, if $f_t|_A$ is independent of $t$.

If $X$ deformation retracts onto $A$ via $f_t$, its terminal map factors through a retraction $r:X\to A$ and the inclusion $i:A\hookrightarrow X$ satisfies $ri=\one _A$ and $ir\simeq \one _X$.
